moments.text: IR view of a mottled grey surface with faint streaks, a brighter patch at left; crosshair, corner marks and an N marker below centre.
A black frame at 33.5 s; from about 35 s a faint light speck shows low in the frame, drifting up and right.
The picture rotates: the N marker swings from lower right to upper right as the view turns and darkens.
Black and white flashes, then about 5 s of plain grey gradient with no detail.
Streaky surface view: a small white dot rises from below the crosshair onto it and stays close by.
A cluster of six or seven bright blobs sweeps from lower right up past the crosshair and out the top: 12 frames, use frame step.
Flashes and plain grey views; from 1:09 a grainy view with a soft bright patch and a box around the crosshair, a faint dot nearby.
Closer view under a dark smudge: a tight group of two or three bright dots rises from the bottom edge and wanders around the crosshair.
After a black frame, the dots, fainter, stay mostly below the crosshair; dark smears drift down the left side 2:19–2:32. Flashes at 3:01–3:04.
A large bright area with a curved edge rises from the bottom, fills the left side, then slides off the left edge by 3:15.
Grainy grey view with a box around the crosshair; small dark specks drift around it, upper left at 3:16, beside the box by 3:26.
Grey views with soft gradients and horizontal bands, a black frame at 4:09 and blocky digital noise at 4:39–4:41.
